states.semantic_audit_reason: Visited-history callback updates canGoBack; only true displays the history-back button.

states.condition: Image analysis returns null, picker cancelled, or caught error
states.description: 錯誤: 無法辨識 QR Code; 確認 closes dialog. Barrier dismissal disabled.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Photo tap invokes scanFromImage; null (including cancellation or caught errors) opens a non-barrier-dismissible error dialog.

states.description: 條碼示意圖 with QR illustration; 關閉 closes dialog. Barrier dismissal disabled.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Help tap invokes showInfo; the shared dialog disables barrier dismissal.

states.description: Displays error code-specific message and optional details.
states.semantic_audit_reason: MobileScanner errorBuilder displays error-code-specific text and optional details.

states.description: 是否要開啟 Google Map; 開啟 sends launch_map bridge message with map URL; 取消 closes. A negative bridge result opens URL in a new window.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Store-address tap opens dialog; positive sends map bridge request; a negative bridge response falls back to window.open.

states.description: 確認使用本優惠? 使用 closes this dialog and opens exchange-success dialog; 取消 closes. No coupon mutation appears in this handler.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Use button opens confirmation; positive opens exchange success, without a redemption mutation in this handler.

states.condition: 加入票夾 when needUse query is absent
states.description: 領取本優惠? 存入票夾 closes this dialog and opens store-success dialog; 取消 closes. No wallet mutation appears in this handler.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Store button is shown when needUse is absent; confirmation opens success without a wallet mutation in this handler.

states.description: 領取成功，已存入我的票夾; 使用優惠 routes to wallet tab 2; 更多優惠 routes to coupon tab 2. The shown success text alone does not prove storage.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Store confirmation opens success dialog; its two actions route to wallet tab 2 or coupon tab 2.

states.description: 優惠已兌換; 確定 closes dialog. The shown success text alone does not prove redemption.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Use confirmation opens exchange success dialog; displayed success does not establish redemption.

states.description: Lists five categories; selecting one stores local selection and closes overlay; barrier dismissal toggles it closed.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Dropdown tap toggles the portal; selecting an enum value saves it locally and toggles the overlay; barrier also toggles it.

states.description: 請選擇取書館; supports nearby and district tabs, radio selection emits selected library ID immediately; close icon or dialog close dismisses. Maps loader and location request run on component mount; on geolocation error it marks map ready, default position remains. Selection itself does not close dialog. District radio change also emits the current library inputValue, which can be empty or stale.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Pickup selector click opens LibrarySelectDialog; radio change emits inputValue but does not close; close icon and Dialog close dismiss. District radio also emits the current library inputValue, possibly empty or stale; map load and location affect nearby list.

states.condition: Attempt selecting an additional series when selected count is at least 7
states.description: 提醒: displays limit 7 and 關閉. Condition checks selected series count, despite displayed wording referring to existing reservations.
states.semantic_audit_reason: checkLimit opens the warning for an additional selection at seven; its positive button closes. The condition counts current selections, not existing reservations as the wording implies.

states.condition: At least one selected series is not already reserved
states.description: 預約成功 displays count, pickup library and external library link; 返回首頁 and 查看預約清單 route to library home and records tab. Record updates are demonstration local storage, not a verified live reservation.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Submit with a new series opens success and updates local store/localStorage; buttons navigate to library home or records. Live reservation is not established.

states.condition: All selected series duplicate existing records
states.description: 預約失敗 displays selected count, title and duplicate reason; 返回首頁 and 查看預約清單 route to library home and records tab.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Submit with zero new reservations opens failure with duplicate message; both buttons navigate. Zero selected series also meets that condition if handler is invoked outside disabled UI.

states.condition: Click 圖書館 in success dialog
states.description: 提醒 that app will be left; 取消 reopens success dialog; 確認 opens external library website.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Library link in success closes it and opens warning; cancel reopens success, confirm creates and clicks a new-tab anchor.

states.description: Google Maps prompt; 開啟 sends launch_map bridge message with selected address URL; 取消 closes.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Address opens map confirmation; positive posts selected address to launch_map, negative closes.

states.description: 通報成功 and 感謝您提供寶貴資訊; 確認 routes to police-report. Form handler logs data and does not establish actual submission.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Detail-form pass opens success after logging; confirm routes to police-report; no submission is established.

states.description: Address input and map; 確認 emits address to parent and closes; close icon dismisses. Map/geocoding API keys are empty in source, and bridge location request occurs in component.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Location button opens shared modal; confirm returns address, close dismisses; mapping services need configuration.

states.condition: Valid form submit sets isSubmitSuccess and opens dialog
states.description: Conditional success/error wording; reviewed submit handler opens success branch on successful validation, logs form, and confirm routes home only when isSubmitSuccess.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Valid submit logs form and opens success; confirm routes home only on success; no failure opener or real submission established.

states.description: Warning about entering payment-provider page; 是 routes to finished screen; 否 closes. Reviewed code does not contact a payment provider.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Payment method updates local payment info and opens warning; confirm routes to finished rather than showing evidence of provider payment; negative closes.

states.description: Warning asks about entering provider; 是 routes to payment-finished, 否 closes. Handler does not contact payment provider.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Payment method updates payment info and opens warning; confirm routes to finished; provider payment is not established.

states.condition: QR data cannot be decoded or does not match fee ID
states.description: 讀取失敗 / 此類型的行動條碼不適用; 重新掃描 closes dialog and posts qr_code_scan bridge message.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Invalid decoded data or no matching fee opens error; retry closes and posts qr_code_scan bridge message.

states.condition: isDialogOpen true; no setter opening it found in this view
states.description: 提醒 about leaving for Taipei library site; 確認 opens external URL, 取消 closes. Normal entry point not established.
states.semantic_audit_reason: isDialogOpen initializes false and is only assigned false in this view; no opener is established. If opened, positive uses an external anchor and negative closes.

states.description: 請啟用定位服務 and explanation; 確認 closes modal.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Position error code 1 opens location-permission notice; confirm closes it.

states.condition: Tap 變更 while regularly used list nonempty
states.description: 請選擇要移除的地點; checkboxes select names, 移除地點 updates store flags and closes; Dialog close dismisses.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Change link appears with regularly used entries and opens selection; remove clears selected flags in store and closes; dialog close also dismisses.

states.description: 是否要開啟 Google Map; 開啟 sends launch_map bridge message; false bridge response opens URL in new window; 取消 closes.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Address click opens confirmation; positive sends launch_map bridge message and a false response opens a new window; negative closes.

states.condition: Submit with nonempty title and description
states.description: 案件已完成受理; 確認 routes to citizen report home. No submission request in handler.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Submit opens success when title and description are nonempty; confirm routes to citizen-report; no submission request in handler.

states.description: Address/map modal; confirm emits address and closes; map and geocode keys are empty in source.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Location button opens shared modal, whose confirm emits address and closes; map configuration and runtime are unverified.

states.description: Shows four ticket types and hard-coded 2024 date ranges; 確認 closes.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Usage-information button opens modal with hard-coded ticket dates; confirm closes.

states.description: 是否要開啟 Google Map; 開啟 sends launch_map bridge message; false result opens URL in new window; 取消 closes.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Address opens map warning; confirm sends launch_map; false bridge response opens new window; cancel closes.

states.condition: Click 圖書館網站 in either notices or empty view
states.description: 提醒 about leaving for library website; 確認 opens https://tpml.gov.taipei/Default.aspx in a new tab; 取消 closes.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Library website links in either list or empty view open warning; confirm clicks a new-tab anchor, cancel closes.

states.condition: Search sees any falsy initialized form value
states.description: 提醒 / 請確認資料是否含空白或符號; 確認 closes. Validation tests truthiness and does not actually scan characters as dialog wording suggests.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Search opens warning when a form value is falsy; confirm closes. Truthiness does not check symbols or whitespace as message suggests.

states.description: Police detail location icon opens shared address/map modal; confirm updates form address, close dismisses. Keys for map and geocoding are empty in source.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Location button opens shared modal; its confirmation assigns address and closes; keys and runtime need verification.

states.description: Shared attachment-info dialog varies its format/size instructions by report type. Information button opens it; 確認 and close event dismiss. Files are held in form-store state; source includes TODO for sending to an API. Although report UI displays total 40 MB, the inspected handler does not enforce a 40 MB aggregate limit.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Info button opens instructions varying by report type; confirm or dialog close dismisses; upload API and aggregate 40MB enforcement are not established.

states.description: 清空搜集紀錄 / 清空您的歷史搜尋紀錄; 取消 closes, 確認 empties in-memory history.
states.semantic_audit_reason: History clear opens confirmation without expanding parent; cancel closes; confirm clears in-memory history.

states.description: 選項 checkbox list; 確認 emits checked values and closes; dialog close dismisses. After confirmation, the parent 變更 button invokes the emitted opener to reopen.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Empty selection opens dialog directly; confirm emits checked values and an opener callback. With selected values, the parent 變更 button invokes that callback to reopen; dialog close dismisses.

states.description: 提醒 / 搜尋不到此地址，請重新輸入; default 確認 closes. Shared by report forms; empty API key and network affect behavior.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Typing triggers geocode; zero returned results opens alert; default positive closes. Empty API key and request failures limit reachability.

states.description: 請啟用定位服務 with explanation; 確認 closes.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Position error code 1 opens notice; confirm closes.

states.description: 案件已完成申辦 with query guidance; 前往查看 goes home with isSearch=true; 確認 goes home. Submission API code is commented.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Preview submit logs and opens completion; positive routes home with isSearch=true, negative home; request example is commented.

states.description: Map confirmation shows selected location; 開啟 sends launch_map bridge message, 取消 closes.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Pickup-address click selects record and opens map dialog; confirm posts launch_map, cancel clears selection.

states.condition: 延長兩日 tapped on eligible record
states.description: Shows title, call number and limit; 確認 increments local extend count and pickup date then opens success dialog; 取消 closes.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Eligible record opens extension dialog; confirm increments local record only if extend_count < 1 and opens success; cancel clears selection.

states.description: 延長兩日成功 shows title and call number; 關閉 clears selection and closes. No live library request established.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Extension success opens when local count is below one; close clears selected record. No live library operation is shown.

states.condition: 取消預約 tapped on ordering record
states.description: Shows title and call number; 取消預約 filters local ordering records and writes localStorage; 我再想想 closes.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Cancel-reservation click selects record and opens dialog; confirm filters ordering store and writes localStorage, negative clears selection. No live cancellation is shown.

states.description: Map confirmation shows selected library name; 開啟 posts launch_map, 取消 closes.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Library address click opens map confirmation; confirm posts launch_map with selected address; cancel closes.

states.condition: Loading is false and filtered list for selected message type is empty
states.description: Shows 目前無訊息 and the filter suggestion.
states.semantic_audit_reason: Reactive list displays empty widget when loading is false and filtered list empty; no user-triggered opener.

states.condition: Selected file exceeds 10 MB for disaster or 20 MB for police, rounded to two decimal MB
states.description: Displays 檔案大小超過限制. A subsequently accepted file clears the warning. Citizen report mode does not enforce the displayed aggregate 40 MB limit in this handler.
states.semantic_audit_reason: File change sets the inline warning according to props and rounded per-file size; no aggregate report-size check or upload API is implemented in this handler.

note: Recorded states semantically source-reviewed; runtime behavior remains unverified.
